name: @cmdctrl/example-daemon
description: Minimal CmdCtrl daemon reference implementation built on @cmdctrl/daemon-sdk - use as a starting point for custom daemons

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && node -e "const p=require('./package.json');const c=require('./dist/context.js');if(c.DAEMON_VERSION!==p.version){console.error('ERROR: DAEMON_VERSION '+c.DAEMON_VERSION+' does not match package.json '+p.version+'. A daemon that under-reports its version makes the server push updates it can never satisfy.');process.exit(1)}"
